heading: 60cm 500 Series Freestanding Cooker, Ceramic
productFeatures: 60cm ceramic cooktop with four cook zones, 88L oven with 11 functions, including Air Fry, Steam assisted cooking and cleaning using the cavity, Pair with a matching Haier 60cm Rangehood for a modern, cohesive look
shortDesc: With a compact design, intuitive controls, and modern styling, this Freestanding Cooker makes it simple to upgrade your kitchen
webCopy: Discover an all-in-one electric cooker that makes entertaining, family meals, and weekend feasts convenient. This Haier 60cm 500 Series Freestanding Cooker combines a sleek four-zone ceramic cooktop with an 88L oven. 11 functions, including Air Fry, fan bake, grill and steam-assisted cooking, help you serve everything from easy weeknight dishes to weekend roasts. Steam-assisted cleaning, simple controls, and a clear glass door make this Haier cooker a versatile kitchen appliance.
